guide.title: Simple guide
guide.intro: You do not need to understand the image algorithm. Choose the settings you like and press Generate.
guide.quick.title: Quick start
guide.quick.1: Choose Planet or Galaxy, then static images or frame animation; desktop Lite supports static images only.
guide.quick.2: Adjust the style, size, and optional effects. Seeds are fully random by default.
guide.quick.3: Press Generate and check the result on the right.
guide.quick.4: Press Save image, Save all images, or Save all frames. Your browser downloads the result directly.
guide.planet.title: Generating planets
guide.planet.body: Style controls the base colors. Size controls pixel detail. Scale enlarges the pixels without changing terrain. With corner-frame variants enabled, Random and Avoid duplicates generate plain, hover, pressed, and disabled sets; Reproduce generates only the three framed sets.
guide.planet.ocean: Ocean coverage ranges from 30% to 90% in 10% steps. Higher values leave less land.
guide.galaxy.title: Generating galaxies
guide.galaxy.body: Theme controls background, nebula, and starlight colors. Seamless axes only control edge wrapping, not star movement; ordinary stars twinkle in fixed positions during animation.
guide.galaxy.stars: Star amount ranges from 30% to 90% in 10% steps; the default is 60%. The maximum size is 1024×1024.
guide.galaxy.spiral: The central spiral is off by default. Enable it to show a spiral in static images or an independently rotating spiral in animations; ordinary stars stay in place.
guide.seed.title: Using seeds
guide.seed.random: Fully random: draws one seed each time without guaranteeing uniqueness. Web and desktop Full use 0–2147483647; desktop Lite uses 0–49.
guide.seed.input: Enter seeds: in Avoid duplicates mode, the input is the exclusion list. Separate multiple values with commas.
guide.seed.reproduce: Reproduce: only the first seed is used; later values are ignored. An empty input triggers an alert. Keep the style, size, colors, and other settings unchanged to reproduce an image.
guide.seed.avoid: Avoid duplicates: draws one seed outside the input list and seeds already generated for the same generator on this page. Refreshing clears this history; seeds are not stored in cookies.
guide.seed.scan: Automatic lookup appears only in Avoid duplicates mode, with no preset folder. After read permission is granted, it scans names recursively and replaces the input with an editable comma-separated list. Names such as earth-123.png and galaxy_animation-deep_blue-123.zip are recognized. ZIP contents and current button-state filenames are not scanned; add those seeds manually.
guide.seed.folderLimit: If the browser refuses a system folder such as Downloads, create a regular subfolder such as PixelPlanetOutput inside it and select that subfolder.
guide.output.title: Saving files
guide.output.folder: A single static result is saved as PNG. Animation frames or multiple results are packed into a ZIP automatically.
guide.output.download: The download location follows your browser settings; some browsers ask where to save each download.
guide.language.title: Language
guide.language.body: Chinese and English are built in and can be switched from the top-right menu at any time.
guide.compat.title: Good to know
guide.compat.body: Web and current desktop interfaces share a renderer: matching seeds and settings reproduce the same content. Legacy Python/Pillow script APIs use a different algorithm. Folder lookup requires browser directory-picker support and permission; otherwise enter seeds manually.
guide.tips.title: Tips
guide.tips.1: For more land, lower the ocean coverage.
guide.tips.2: Animations support 15–60 frames and download as a ZIP of PNG frames, not a GIF or video. More frames take longer to generate and save.
guide.tips.3: Custom ring and corner-frame colors appear only when their effects are enabled; pressed and disabled colors appear when state variants are enabled. Built-in styles share the same default frame colors.
guide.tips.4: For game backgrounds, try horizontal or two-axis seamless galaxies.
faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.intro: Common questions about generation, saving, seeds, and browser permissions.
faq.generate.a: You can generate static PNG pixel planets, pixel galaxies, and PNG frame animations. Planet controls include ocean coverage, colors, and rings; galaxy controls include star amount, seamless axes, and an optional central spiral.
faq.browser.a: A recent version of Chrome or Edge is recommended. Other modern browsers can usually generate and download images, but folder reading for automatic existing-seed lookup may be limited.
faq.seed.q: What is the difference between random, reproduce, and avoid duplicates?
faq.seed.a: Fully random creates a new seed automatically. Reproduce uses only the first entered seed. Avoid duplicates excludes the entered list and seeds already used during the current page session.
faq.scan.q: How does automatic existing-seed lookup work?
faq.scan.a: This option appears only in Avoid duplicates mode. After you authorize a folder, the page extracts seeds from files or directories that follow the default naming pattern and places them in an editable, comma-separated input.
faq.folder.q: Why can I not select a system folder such as Downloads?
faq.folder.a: Browsers may block direct access to protected system directories. Create a regular subfolder there, such as PixelPlanetOutput, and select that subfolder instead.
faq.output.a: When you press a save button, your browser downloads the file to its configured location or asks where to save it. Multiple images and animations are packed into ZIP files.
faq.animation.a: Animations are saved as sequentially numbered PNG frames and automatically packed into a ZIP download.
faq.compatibility.q: Will a web seed produce exactly the same image in the desktop edition?
faq.compatibility.a: Not necessarily. Seeds reproduce within the web edition, but the web renderer and Python/Pillow desktop renderer use different implementations and are not pixel-identical.
faq.privacy.a: No. The current version generates images locally in your browser and does not upload generated images or settings to a project server. See the Privacy page for details.
faq.license.q: Can I use generated images commercially?
faq.license.a: Yes, in personal or commercial finished works, with attribution to the project or author. You may not resell generated images themselves or substantially unchanged asset packs. See the License page for details.
about.title: About & contact
about.intro: A lightweight, reproducible, and privacy-minded pixel planet and galaxy generator.
about.project.title: About the project
about.project.body: Pixel Art Planet Generator helps you quickly create pixel-art planets, galaxies, and animation frames. The web edition renders and saves directly in your browser.
about.author.title: Author
about.author.body: This project is maintained and published by Barubear.
about.contact.title: Contact
about.source.title: Source code
about.source.body: Visit GitHub for the source code, release updates, and issue history.
privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: We aim to keep generation on your device and use only the browser capabilities needed for actions you choose.
privacy.scope.title: Scope
privacy.scope.body: This policy applies to the Pixel Art Planet Generator web edition. The current version has no account system, analytics, or advertising services.
privacy.processing.title: Local generation
privacy.processing.body: Images, settings, and seeds are processed in your browser. The page does not upload generated images or generation settings to a project server.
privacy.storage.title: Browser storage
privacy.storage.body: The page uses browser local storage only for your language preference. Used seeds and scan results are used only during the current page session. Your browser may separately keep download history.
privacy.folder.title: Local folder read permission
privacy.folder.body: The page reads matching file or directory names only after you enable automatic existing-seed lookup and choose a folder. It does not modify that folder or upload its files. Close the page or use browser settings to revoke permission.
privacy.cookies.title: Cookies and advertising
privacy.cookies.body: The current version sets no cookies and uses no advertising, trackers, or visitor analytics. The language preference is saved with local storage, not a cookie.
privacy.hosting.title: Hosting and external links
privacy.hosting.body: If you access this page through GitHub or another hosting provider, that provider may process IP addresses, browser information, and request logs under its own policy. External sites apply their own privacy policies after you follow a link.
privacy.children.title: Children's privacy
privacy.children.body: The project does not require registration and does not intentionally collect children's personal information. Contact us if you believe personal information was submitted accidentally.
privacy.changes.title: Policy updates
privacy.changes.body: This policy may be updated when features or data practices change. The effective date on this page will be revised.

privacy.contact.body: For questions about this policy or the project's data practices, email:
